import json
from scipy.special import erf
gelu=lambda x: 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
k=np.load('kernel_v3.npz'); f3=np.load('my3_feats.npz')
C=k['C'].astype(np.float64); yc=k['yc']; n=1496
Call=np.vstack([C,f3['Z'].astype(np.float64)]); yall=np.concatenate([yc,f3['y']]); src=np.concatenate([np.zeros(n),np.ones(len(yc)-n),2*np.ones(len(f3['y']))]).astype(int)
K=gelu(Call@Call.T/768)
errs={}
for seed in range(3):
    f=np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n)%5; P=np.zeros((n,8))
    for j in range(5):
        trp=np.where(f!=j)[0]; te=np.where(f==j)[0]; tr=np.concatenate([trp, np.where(src>0)[0]])
        w=np.where(src[tr]==0,1.0,0.3); Tm=np.eye(8)[yall[tr]]; b=(w[:,None]*Tm).sum(0)/w.sum()
        A=np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(tr,tr)]+0.03*np.diag(1/w),Tm-b); P[te]=K[np.ix_(te,tr)]@A+b
    for i in np.where(P.argmax(1)!=yc[:n])[0]: errs[i]=errs.get(i,0)+1; 
    print(seed,(P.argmax(1)==yc[:n]).mean())
    if seed==0: P0=P
pr=practice()
for i in sorted(errs,key=lambda i:-errs[i]): print(errs[i], f"[{LABELS[yc[i]][:10]} -> {LABELS[P0[i].argmax()][:10]}] {pr[i]['text']}")
